name: event_name
description: Snake_case event name from sGTM (page_view, click_nav, product_view, purchase, etc.)

name: timestamp
description: Client-side ISO 8601 timestamp (event parameter from data layer)

name: received_timestamp
description: Server-side epoch milliseconds when sGTM processed the event

name: session_id
description: Session identifier from first-party cookie (event parameter)

name: client_id
description: GA4 client ID from cookie (sGTM Common Event Data)

name: page_location
description: Full page URL (sGTM Common Event Data)

name: page_path
description: URL pathname (sGTM Common Event Data)

name: page_title
description: Document title (sGTM Common Event Data)

name: page_referrer
description: Full referrer URL (sGTM Common Event Data)

name: depth_percentage
description: Scroll depth percentage (scroll_depth events)

name: depth_pixels
description: Scroll depth in pixels (scroll_depth events)

name: link_text
description: Navigation link text (click_nav events)

name: link_url
description: Navigation link URL (click_nav events)

name: cta_text
description: CTA button text (click_cta events)

name: cta_location
description: CTA location on page (click_cta events)

name: form_name
description: Form identifier (form_* events)

name: field_name
description: Form field name (form_field_focus events)

name: form_success
description: Whether form submission succeeded (form_submit events)

name: consent_analytics
description: Analytics consent state (consent_update events)

name: consent_marketing
description: Marketing consent state (consent_update events)

name: consent_preferences
description: Preferences consent state (consent_update events)

name: user_agent
description: User agent string (sGTM Common Event Data)

name: ip_override
description: Client IP (sGTM Common Event Data, anonymized in Dataform staging)

name: utm_source
description: UTM source parameter (google, facebook, tiktok, email, etc.)

name: utm_medium
description: UTM medium parameter (cpc, paid_social, email, organic, etc.)

name: utm_campaign
description: UTM campaign name — raw value, may contain inconsistent naming

name: iap_source
description: Flag indicating event came from iampatterson data generator ('true')

name: iap_session_id
description: IAP-specific session ID (UUID, mirrors session_id for generator events)

name: product_id
description: Product identifier (product_view, add_to_cart events)

name: product_name
description: Product display name (product_view, add_to_cart events)

name: product_price
description: Product unit price in USD (product_view, add_to_cart events)

name: product_category
description: Product category (product_view events)

name: quantity
description: Quantity added to cart (add_to_cart events)

name: cart_total
description: Cart total in USD (begin_checkout events)

name: item_count
description: Number of items in cart/order (begin_checkout, purchase events)

name: order_id
description: Order identifier (purchase events)

name: order_total
description: Order total in USD (purchase events)

name: products
description: JSON-serialized product array [{product_id, product_name, price, quantity}] (purchase events)

name: plan_id
description: Subscription plan identifier (plan_select, trial_signup, renewal, churn events)

name: plan_name
description: Subscription plan display name (plan_select, trial_signup, renewal, churn events)

name: plan_price
description: Subscription plan monthly price in USD (plan_select, trial_signup events)

name: renewal_month
description: Renewal month number since signup (subscription_renewal events)

name: revenue
description: Revenue amount in USD (subscription_renewal events)

name: tenure_months
description: Months subscribed before churn (subscription_churn events)

name: reason
description: Churn reason (subscription_churn events)

name: partnership_type
description: Partnership type selected (form_complete, lead_qualify events)

name: budget_range
description: Budget range selected (form_complete, lead_qualify events)

name: company_name
description: Company name from form (form_complete events)

name: lead_id
description: Lead identifier (lead_qualify events)

name: qualification_tier
description: Lead qualification tier: high, medium, low (lead_qualify events)

name: dismissal_mode
description: How the first-session nav hint was dismissed: scroll, click_outside, timeout (nav_hint_dismissed events, Phase 9E deliverable 9; click_session_pulse removed post-UAT — clicks on SessionPulse are conversions, tracked by click_cta + cta_location='session_pulse')

name: source
description: Tab landing source: default_landing (overlay opened onto this tab) or manual_select (tab clicked from the tabs bar) — carried by overview_tab_view, timeline_tab_view, consent_tab_view (Phase 9E deliverable 9)

name: destination
description: Portal link destination: services, about, contact (portal_click events, Phase 9E deliverable 9)

name: threshold
description: Coverage threshold crossed: 25, 50, 75, 100 (coverage_milestone events, Phase 9E deliverable 9)

name: metric_name
description: Core Web Vitals metric name: LCP, CLS, INP, FCP, TTFB (web_vital events, Phase 10 deliverable 1)

name: metric_value
description: Core Web Vitals metric value — LCP/FCP/TTFB/INP in milliseconds, CLS as a unitless shift score (web_vital events, Phase 10 deliverable 1)

name: metric_rating
description: Google CWV rating bucket applied by the web-vitals library: good, needs-improvement, poor (web_vital events, Phase 10 deliverable 1)

name: metric_id
description: Per-metric unique ID from the web-vitals library, lets dedupe in BQ if a metric fires twice on the same page visit (web_vital events, Phase 10 deliverable 1)

name: navigation_type
description: Navigation API navigation_type: navigate, reload, back-forward, back-forward-cache, prerender, restore (web_vital events, Phase 10 deliverable 1; used to segment CWV by first-visit vs bfcache restore)

name: engagement_seconds
description: Page-level engagement threshold crossed: 15, 60, or 180 seconds of foreground-tab engaged time (page_engagement events, Phase 10d D3). Counter pauses on document.hidden and resumes on visible, so this is real engaged time, not wall-clock time-on-page.

name: max_scroll_pct
description: High-water-mark scroll percentage at the moment of firing, 0-100, unbucketed (page_engagement events, Phase 10d D3). Closes scroll_depth's milestone-bucket information loss: a session that scrolled to 87% on a long page records 87 here, not the 75% milestone bucket.

name: direction
description: Translation direction on /claudish: en_to_claudish or claudish_to_en (claudish_translate / claudish_share / claudish_rate events, feat/claudish).

name: source_mode
description: How the translation fired: auto (debounced translate-as-you-type) or manual (swap/explicit action) (claudish_translate).

name: detected_language
description: Client-side detection result at firing: en, en-x-claudish, or none (claudish_translate / claudish_detected).

name: detector_source
description: Which detector answered: ccld (trained model) or heuristic (regex fallback) (claudish_translate / claudish_detected).

name: outcome
description: Terminal translation outcome: complete, refused, capacity, or error. Aborted requests never fire (claudish_translate).

name: input_chars
description: Input length in UTF-16 units — never the input text itself; 'no input bodies logged' extends to analytics (claudish events).

name: input_em_dashes
description: Em-dash count in the input at firing — the counter's tail, and the joke's KPI (claudish_translate).

name: output_chars
description: Output length; 0 on refusal since partials are discarded (claudish events).

name: ttft_ms
description: Time to first streamed token in ms; 0 on cache hits and non-complete outcomes (claudish_translate).

name: duration_ms
description: Total request duration in ms (claudish_translate).

name: cache
description: Which cache served: miss, client, or server (claudish_translate).

name: share_action
description: Distribution action: copy_output, copy_link, web_share, or opened_shared_link (claudish_share).

name: share_truncated
description: Whether the share-URL budget truncated the payload to an excerpt (claudish_share).

name: share_url_chars
description: Share URL length — a LENGTH only; the URL itself encodes the input text and never lands anywhere (claudish_share).

name: rating
description: Thumb rating: holds_up or absolutely_right (claudish_rate).
